description:
OUTRO ticket for fz-hwn.27. The cleanup gate -- the epic is not done until the triggers are gone.

Acceptance criteria (proposal.html):
- New machinery correct in isolation -- Step 1 unit tests pass: (a,b) != (a,a), repeated-name unification, cross-depth Underconstrained, input<->result identity.
- The conflation is gone -- no per-position alpha normalization remains; an activation key is the canonical arrow by construction.
- fz-hwn.23 falls out -- compiler2_interp_runs_enum_with_index_mapper_from_backend_artifacts is re-enabled and green for the RIGHT reason: no value-template activation reaches the backend.
- NO TRIGGER SURVIVES -- grep -rn "Trash\|trash_" src/ returns nothing. Every renamed concept is REMOVED, not merely hidden. Any trigger still standing means a caller still leans on dead code: that is unfinished body work, not an outro deferral.
- Whole-suite green, zero warnings -- lib + fixture matrix, verified from a fresh uniquely-marked run (feedback_verify_green_before_commit).

If any symbol cannot yet be removed, the blocking consumer is a NEW ticket on this epic, not a silent deferral (feedback_no_silent_deferrals).

Depends on: contract.rs collapse (fz-hwn.27.9), fz-hwn.23.

comments.text: Acceptance scoping (found at HEAD): grep -rn 'Trash\|trash_' src/ has PRE-EXISTING hits NOT owned by fz-hwn.27: (1) ir_codegen/function.rs trash_tuple_return_delivery_plan (a stale marker from a prior cleanup -- candidate for its own removal ticket), (2) transport_contract_test.rs assert_no_trash_authority + a fact.contains("Trash") guard (a different, legitimate 'Trash authority' check). The outro grep must EXCLUDE these (scope to the fz-hwn.27 kill-list: contract.rs Trash* surface types + any addressed-arrow markers), or they will falsely fail the criterion. As of 27.4, the fz-hwn.27-owned markers are only the contract.rs Trash* SURFACE types (TrashContractArrow/TrashAppliedContractArrow) + their uses in contract_test.rs, removed by 27.9; plus a doc-comment reference in resolve.rs. The contract.rs witness/substitution ENGINE markers were already removed (relocated to Types in 27.4).

Outro verification gate — all acceptance criteria met, no code change needed (the fz-hwn.27-owned triggers were removed by the body tickets):
(1) Step-1 machinery green: distinct_params_do_not_conflate_with_repeated_params ((a,b)!=(a,a)), input_to_result_identity_is_preserved, repeated_name_unifies_to_the_first_occurrence_address, shared_name_crosses_depth (cross-depth Underconstrained) — all pass.
(2) Conflation gone: alpha_normalize_vars retired (fz-hwn.27.15); the activation key is the canonical arrow by construction (fz-hwn.27.6/.7); both binders address (key-mint .6/.7, resolver .14).
(3) fz-hwn.23 falls out: compiler2_interp_runs_enum_with_index_mapper_from_backend_artifacts re-enabled and green (no value-template activation reaches the backend).
(4) No trigger survives: grep -rn 'Trash|trash_' src/ returns only the legitimate assert_no_trash_authority guard (the excluded pre-existing non-.27 hit per the scoping comment); contract.rs Trash* surface types removed in .9, resolve.rs doc reference gone.
(5) Whole-suite green, zero warnings: lib 1034/0, matrix 305/0, clippy -D warnings clean.

title: Remove every Trash/trash_ trigger; prove the conflation is gone and the suite is green
